answer: The horizon schedule is applied in forge and tundra shows each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2872 identities would post 506 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
